OBJECTIVE: To leverage my 5 years of experience in ServiceNow development, ITSM implementation, and platform administration to
contribute to organizational growth by delivering efficient solutions, improving business processes, and ensuring high-
quality service management systems.
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY:
5 years of hands-on experience as a ServiceNow Developer and Administrator.
Extensive experience in ServiceNow implementation, customization, enhancement, and support.
Expertise in ITSM modules: Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.

Implemented multiple business value-add solutions to
raw_sections.experience:
experience.
improve operational efficiency and user
Designed and implemented bulk asset data loading solutions, eliminating manual processes and ensuring
data accuracy.
Strong experience in Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Server-
side scripting.
Worked extensively with Import Sets, Transform Maps, and Data Integrations from external sources.
Developed and maintained SOAP and REST API integrations with third-party applications.
Built and enhanced Service Catalogs, Workflows, and Flow Designer solutions for process automation.
Hands-on experience in Service Portal development and customization.

Implemented and maintained Discovery, CMDB, Software Asset Management (SAM), and Hardware Asset Management (HAM).
Experience in Update Set migration, Notifications, Notification Scripts, Reports, Dashboards, and
Homepage Widgets.
Contributed to ServiceNow Mobile App development and platform modernization initiatives.
Participated in ServiceNow upgrades, skipped update remediation, and platform maintenance activities.
Good knowledge of MID Server installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Strong expertise in CMDB, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and custom actions.
Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AngularJS for UI customization and portal
development.
Performed peer reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and implementation governance.
Strong understanding of technical and functional design requirements, solution design, and ServiceNow
best practices.
WORK EXPERIENCE: 
Software Consultant – Bank of America, Hyderabad from Aug 2025 – May 2026.

Software Engineer – TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), Hyderabad from Aug 2021 – July 2025.
Project 1 : ERIE | Aug 2025 – May 2026
Module : ITOM
Role
: Sr. ServiceNow Developer
Roles & Responsibilities:

Customized probs and sensors for data population.

Created SNMP classifications and created discovery schedules.

Created horizontal discovery schedules for Configuration Items.

Implemented new discovery classifications and patterns.

Created De- Duplicate tasks and enhanced CMDB health.
Involved in creating/customizations for Server-side and client-side scripting like Business rules and Script
Includes, Client Script, UI actions & UI Policy

Loaded data into ServiceNow using Various Data sources and integrations.

Enhanced CMDB Health dashboard and Performed Clean-up activities.

Customized the Disposal Order process, Transform Order and Purchase Order processes.

Customized the Software entitlement and Software Asset Workspace.

Improved Asset procurement process by implementing bulk receive purchase items and it helps in cocurate asset procurement.

Enhanced Reclamation candidate flow and created Reclamation rules.

Involved in enhancement of Meraki, Nutanix & Call Manager Integrations.

Create Transform map and Data Sources, Database views and Reports.

Creation and deployment of Update Sets and stagging in different environments.
Environment: ServiceNow
Project 2: R&F| April 2023 – July 2025
Module: ITSM Implementation
Role : ServiceNow Developer
Roles & Responsibilities:

Customized Incident Management and Change Management.

Configured Email Notifications and email scripts.

Involved in Implementation, Customization and Maintenance of ITIL modules such as Incident, Problem, Knowledge.

Created Server-side scripting like Business rules and Script Includes.

Created Client Script, UI Policy and UI Actions.

Generated multiple reports.

Created new Catalogs and Record producers and configured the workflows.

Created new widgets and pages, created reports for the portal and shown then in the portal.

Create Transform map and Data Source.

Created Database views.

Creation and deployment of Update Sets.

Created Workflow and Customized form configuration.
Environment: ServiceNow
Project 3: Grupo Bimbo| August 2021 – March 2023
Module: ITSM Implementation
Roles & Responsibilities:
Configuring Incident, Problem and Change as per the Requirements.
Performs core configuration tasks including Business rules and client scripts.
Manages data with Tables, Database operations, Import Sets, and Update Sets.
Building of Notifications and scripts.

Implemented custom widgets and pages for service portal.
Creation of Groups and Roles and Implemented ACLs
Creation of Scheduled Jobs.
• Generate multiple reports as for client requirements.
Imported data into ServiceNow table from different sources.
Environment: ServiceNow.
